Crispy Honey-Garlic Chicken Fried Rice

Crispy starch-coated chicken tossed in sticky honey-garlic sauce, served with egg-fried rice and vegetables. The creator’s batch makes seven generous, protein-packed portions.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
50 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
10

Ingredients

  • 1.05 kg boneless, skinless chicken breast, diced
  • 35 ml reduced-sodium soy sauce
  • 2 garlic cloves, minced
  • ½ tsp black pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 100 g potato starch for coating (about 40 g sticks)
  • 500 g frozen mixed vegetables
  • 4 eggs + 200 g egg whites (or 5 eggs)
  • 50 g spring onion, sliced and divided
  • 980 g day-old cooked white rice
  • 40 ml reduced-sodium soy sauce
  • Honey-garlic sauce: 5 garlic cloves, minced; 60 ml reduced-sodium soy sauce; 60 ml water; 100 g reduced-sugar ketchup; 25 ml rice-wine vinegar; 80 g honey; 1 tsp cornflour mixed with 80 ml water

Amounts are scaled from 7 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Whisk together the sauce ingredients except the cornflour slurry. Simmer in a small pan; stir in the slurry and cook until glossy and lightly thickened. Set aside.
  2. Toss chicken with 35 ml soy sauce, 2 minced garlic cloves, black pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Coat with potato starch; shake off excess.
  3. Air-fry chicken in batches in a single layer at 400°F (200°C), turning once, until crisp and cooked through to 165°F (74°C). Use a food thermometer to check the thickest pieces.
  4. In a large nonstick skillet, scramble the eggs and egg whites until just set. Transfer to a plate.
  5. Cook the white parts of the spring onion and mixed vegetables in the skillet until hot. Add the day-old rice and 40 ml soy sauce; stir-fry until the rice is hot and separated.
  6. Fold the eggs back into the rice. Toss the crispy chicken with enough warm sauce to coat, then serve over the fried rice. Finish with the green spring onion.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
